subject: Competitive bake-off recap: OmniHealth - Redwood vs CloudAI
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@omnihealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@omnihealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Competitive bake-off recap: OmniHealth - Redwood vs CloudAI

Hi Claire & Tom,

Thanks again for the time today — appreciate the open discussion. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can make the vendor comparison as objective as possible.

Summary of pain points you confirmed:
- High per-token cost and unpredictable monthly spend across current workloads.
- Latency spikes on peak shifts causing degraded UX for clinician chat flows (~300–700ms target, current 800–1200ms).
- Need for strict audit logs and data residency for PHI workflows.

Goals for the bake-off:
1) Verify latency and cost at your typical traffic patterns (50–200 concurrent sessions, avg seq len 256).
2) Validate quality on your clinical Q&A prompts (we agreed to use your sample set of 120 prompts).
3) Confirm security controls: SOC2 evidence, KMS integration, and network isolation options.

How Redwood compares (high-level):
- Performance: Our Dedicated option supports predictable throughput with autoscaling; we’ll run a latency sweep and provide p50/p90/p95.
- Cost controls: batching, prefix caching, and quantization profiles we recommend should materially lower tokens/second cost vs vanilla endpoints.
- Compliance: Private deployment (VPC) option + audit logs; we shared SOC2 and can provide narrower artifacts on request.

Open questions we captured:
- Are you able to share the 120-prompt set and a representative traffic trace (anonymized)?
- Which competitor features are must-haves vs nice-to-haves for decision (e.g., fine-grained rollout controls, on-prem option)?
- Procurement timeline/POC budget constraints?

Proposed next steps / owners:
- Claire: share the prompt set + sample traffic by end of day Tue (4/20).
- OmniHealth: confirm if procurement can allocate a two-week POC budget (ballpark) — Ben to advise.
- Aditya: we will deliver a bake-off plan & metrics template (attached) and schedule the POC run.
- Rishi: run an initial architecture checklist and latency smoke test once we have the trace.

Attachments: bakeoff-metrics-template.xlsx (POC metrics we’ll collect) and redwood-sla-summary.pdf (short doc).

If that all looks right I’ll send a calendar invite for a kick-off and lock the test windows.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
https://redwood.ai
From: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@omnihealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@omnihealth.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Competitive bake-off recap: OmniHealth - Redwood vs CloudAI

Thanks Marissa — helpful summary. I confirmed with Tom and Ben: we can share the prompt set and a scrubbed traffic trace by EOD Tuesday (4/20).

Procurement note from Ben (looping him): we have a $12k budget for a two-week POC; if any vendor requires more we’ll need written justification. Also want clarity on what SLA commitments we can get during the POC window.

Must-haves for the decision: data residency (US-only), audit logs for all requests, and a clear path to private deployment. Everything else is secondary.

We’re happy to move quickly so long as the POC is scoped and we can measure latency/cost/quality objectively. Schedule looks good for the week of 4/26 for the live run.

Claire

--
Claire Dawson

Date: 2027-04-19T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Competitive bake-off recap: OmniHealth - Redwood vs CloudAI

Great — thanks Claire and Ben. I’ve attached the bakeoff-metrics-template.xlsx (same as Marissa attached) with an initial mapping of tests we suggest. Quick plan:

1) Please upload the 120-prompt set and the anonymized trace to the Drive link (I added it to our shared folder).
2) We’ll run a baseline against both Redwood hosted and CloudAI (vendor B) to capture p50/p90/p95 and tokens/1000 metrics.
3) Rishi will run the quantized model runs and an autoscale stress test during the POC window (4/26–5/07).

Action items (short):
- Claire / OmniHealth: upload prompts & trace to https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C by 4/20.
- Ben / Procurement: confirm POC budget and any contractual must-haves by 4/22.
- Marissa / Aditya: share kickoff invite for 4/26 and initial test schedule.

Ben — for budgeting, the two-week POC we propose will include dedicated capacity time for the Redwood side; we estimate ~$8k in committed infra hours but can provide a more detailed breakdown if needed.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite and the exact test matrix.

– Aditya

Adding a few technical notes before the POC kickoff:
- For latency comparability please include the 95th percentile request size and the distribution of session lengths in the trace — that drives kernel selection and batching behavior.
- We’ll need a sample of expected prompts with masked PHI (you can use column IDs instead of names).
- I’ll prepare an initial quants/precision plan (int8 vs int4 tradeoffs) and a runbook for how we execute the throughput runs.

Tentative call for 4/26 at 10:00 AM PT to kick off unless you prefer another time — I’ll wait for Marissa/Aditya to send the invite.

Rishi
Staff ML Engineer | Redwood Inference
